ready_to_play.text: KartPad has ready-to-play downloads for Android, iPhone, iPad and Mac: install one and add your own game data. You don't need PadMint for that. Use PadMint if you'd rather build your own copy, or to make the KartPad game data folder from your disc.

es.text: KartPad tiene descargas listas para jugar en Android, iPhone, iPad y Mac: instala una y añade tus propios datos del juego. Para eso no necesitas PadMint. Usa PadMint si prefieres crear tu propia copia, o para crear la carpeta KartPad game data a partir de tu disco.

pt.text: O KartPad tem downloads prontos para jogar no Android, iPhone, iPad e Mac: instale um e adicione seus próprios dados do jogo. Para isso você não precisa do PadMint. Use o PadMint se preferir criar a sua própria cópia, ou para criar a pasta KartPad game data a partir do seu disco.

notes: Players: padmint make kartpad android|ios (the manifest in KartPad's repository is used). This embedded manifest is the fallback when the release or an older checkout has none; its android target is KartPad v0.7.2's.

steps: Install KartPad-v…-android.apk from https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/releases/latest. It already has the game code, so you don't need {file}. It updates an older KartPad and keeps your saves; don't uninstall first.
Copy the KartPad game data folder from {folder} to the phone or tablet (USB cable, cloud drive or Quick Share).

Open KartPad and tap Import Game on the Mario Kart Wii card. At Game Data & Saves, tap Import from Extracted Game Data Folder, pick the KartPad game data folder, tap Use this folder and Allow, then Done. If you played before, your game data is already there: tap Play Game.
phone_steps: Install KartPad-v…-android.apk from https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/releases/latest. It already has the game code, so you don't need {file}. Update over an older KartPad to keep your saves; don't uninstall first.
Your KartPad game data folder is already on this phone, in {folder}. No computer or file transfer is needed.

Open KartPad and tap Import Game on the Mario Kart Wii card. At Game Data & Saves, tap Import from Extracted Game Data Folder and select the KartPad game data folder in {folder}. Tap Use this folder, then Allow. When the import finishes, tap Done.
android.note: KartPad 0.7.9 and newer for Android include the game code. On Android, PadMint's part is the KartPad game data folder.

steps: Install {file} on your iPhone or iPad with AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly.
Updating? Install it over your existing KartPad with the same tool and Apple ID to keep your saves. Your game data stays too: if KartPad doesn't ask for it, you're ready to play.

First time only: put the KartPad game data folder from {folder} on the device (iCloud Drive, a USB drive or a cloud drive app). In KartPad, tap Import Game next to Mario Kart Wii, then Import from Extracted Folder…, and pick that folder.
Instala {file} en tu iPhone o iPad con AltStore, SideStore o Sideloadly.

¿Actualizas? Instálalo sobre tu KartPad actual con la misma herramienta y el mismo Apple ID para conservar tus partidas. Tus datos del juego también se conservan: si KartPad no los pide, ya puedes jugar.

Solo la primera vez: pon la carpeta KartPad game data de {folder} en el dispositivo (iCloud Drive, una memoria USB o una app de nube). En KartPad, toca Import Game junto a Mario Kart Wii, luego Import from Extracted Folder…, y elige esa carpeta.
Instale {file} no seu iPhone ou iPad com AltStore, SideStore ou Sideloadly.
Atualizando? Instale sobre o seu KartPad atual com a mesma ferramenta e o mesmo Apple ID para manter seus saves. Seus dados do jogo também ficam: se o KartPad não pedir, já pode jogar.

Só na primeira vez: coloque a pasta KartPad game data de {folder} no aparelho (iCloud Drive, um pendrive ou um app de nuvem). No KartPad, toque em Import Game ao lado de Mario Kart Wii, depois em Import from Extracted Folder…, e escolha essa pasta.
